channel.title: Director's Desk: Institutional Real Estate
channel.description: A daily two-host briefing on institutional, healthcare, and higher-ed commercial real estate: lease mechanics, deal economics, negotiation, lease-vs-buy, Stark/FMV compliance, brokerage governance, and ASC 842.
channel.itunes:author: Director's Desk

item.title: Day 2: CAM Pools, Gross-Up Clauses, Controllable Caps, and Audit Rights
item.description: Commercial Lease Mechanics & Deal Fluency — CAM Pools, Gross-Up Clauses, Controllable Caps, and Audit Rights. Rule of thumb: Insist on non-cumulative caps on controllable CAM, consistent base-year gross-up, and explicit capital-expenditure exclusions.

item.title: Day 1: NNN, Modified Gross, and Full-Service Leases: How Money Actually Moves
item.description: Commercial Lease Mechanics & Deal Fluency — NNN, Modified Gross, and Full-Service Leases: How Money Actually Moves. Rule of thumb: Always convert competing quotes to 5-year all-in occupancy cost per USF/RSF before comparing headline rents.
